items.title: CISA Warns of VMware Tools and Aria Operations 0-Day Vulnerability Exploited in Attacks
items.description: The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) has added CVE-2025-41244 to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. This local privilege escalation flaw affects Broadcom’s VMware Aria Operations and VMware Tools, with evidence of active exploitation in the wild. Security researchers and officials urge immediate patching to prevent potential ransomware and other attacks that…
